analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 42.1 remains in neutral territory, indicating a lack of direction. MACD histogram is improving but still in negative territory. ADX at 25.4 suggests an early stage of trend formation, but -DI is still above +DI, indicating residual downward pressure.
